item.title: Air Theremin – a browser theremin you play by waving at your webcam
item.description:
📝 Air Theremin · Play With Motion Or Hand Tracking — 0 HZ 0:00 TILT ↔ VOLUME · TILT ↕ PITCH · TOUCH TO PLAY · OUTSIDE FRAME = SILENCE ✋✋ SPREAD HANDS = LOUDER PALMS TOGETHER = SILENCE ✋✋ RAISE BOTH HANDS = HIGHER KEEP BOTH HANDS IN VIEW ✋✋ TILT LIKE A SEE-SAW = VIBRATO LEAN BACK = DARKER, MORE ROOM TAP TO PLAY // INPUT ⟲ GYRO ◉ HANDS ◎ CAL // WAVE ∿ SINE △ TRI ◠ WARM ⊔ REED REVERB NOTE SNAP // FX ∿ VIB ≋ TREM ⟳ ECHO ● REC ❚❚ PAUSE ▛ AIR·THEREMIN ▜ Play it in mid-air, two ways. HANDS — wave both hands at the camera: spread them apart for volume, raise them for pitch, lean back to soften the tone, put your palms together for silence. GYRO — on a phone, tilt it instead: left-right sets volume, forward-back sets pitch, and the whole range lives inside the frame (tilt the marker outside it to cut the sound).
🔗 Read more: https://theremin.bizibah.com/
